# CipherTrivia

> CipherTrivia is a cybersecurity services company in Bengaluru, India, and the cybersecurity practice of Nextwebi IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. It provides VAPT (vulnerability assessment and penetration testing), penetration testing, web, mobile and API security testing, cloud and network security, security architecture review, DevSecOps, SOC as a Service, security compliance, cybersecurity consulting and AI/LLM security testing, combining AI-assisted analysis with validation by security experts.

- Website: https://www.ciphertrivia.com/
- Phone: +91 90083 72466
- Email: projects@ciphertrivia.com
- Office: 4th Floor M-Park, Doddanekundi 2nd Stage, Mahadevpura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, India
- Response time: within one business day, Monday–Friday IST
- Parent company: Nextwebi IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (https://www.nextwebi.com/), 600+ clients across 20+ countries; the certifications (ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO 9001:2015, D-U-N-S® registered) are held by Nextwebi
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ciphertrivia, https://x.com/ciphertrivia, https://github.com/ciphertrivia

## Services

- [Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing Services Company](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/vapt-security-services/): CipherTrivia combines automated vulnerability assessment with expert-led penetration testing to identify security gaps, validate real-world risks and provide clear remediation guidance.
- [Penetration Testing Services to Identify Security Vulnerabilities](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/penetration-testing/): CipherTrivia delivers penetration testing services to identify security vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, networks and cloud environments with actionable remediation guidance.
- [Web App Security Testing Services for Vulnerability Detection](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/web-application-security-testing/): CipherTrivia provides web app security testing and penetration testing services to identify vulnerabilities, assess security risks and strengthen web application protection.
- [Mobile App Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/mobile-application-security-testing/): Strengthen mobile app security with Android and iOS security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, API security testing and comprehensive mobile application security audits.
- [API Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/api-security-testing/): Strengthen API security with API Security Testing Services, API Vulnerability Assessment and API Penetration Testing to identify security flaws and protect sensitive data with CipherTrivia
- [CLOUD SECURITY SERVICES](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/cloud-security-services/): CipherTrivia provides cloud security services for AWS, Azure and GCP, covering vulnerability assessments, IAM reviews, configuration audits, network segmentation, storage security and compliance mapping against CIS Benchmarks and Well-Architected Frameworks.
- [Network Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/network-security-testing/): Secure your IT infrastructure with network security testing services from CipherTrivia. Identify vulnerabilities through network penetration testing and security assessments.
- [Security Architecture Review Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/security-architecture-review/): Identify security gaps with security architecture review services covering application design and cloud infrastructure along with network security and access controls.
- [DevSecOps Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/devsecops-services/): Strengthen software security with CipherTrivia’s DevSecOps services covering CI/CD pipeline security, automated vulnerability scanning, infrastructure as code (IaC) security and continuous security testing across the SDLC.
- [Security Operations Center as a Service (SOCaaS)](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/soc-as-a-service/): Secure your business with Security Operations Center as a Service (SOCaaS) from CipherTrivia, offering 24/7 threat monitoring, security incident detection, threat intelligence and incident response support.
- [Security Compliance Services for Businesses](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/security-compliance/): CipherTrivia provides security compliance services to help businesses align with ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA and GDPR through risk assessments, security audits and compliance gap analysis.
- [Cyber Security Consulting Services for Business Risk Management](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/cybersecurity-consulting/): CipherTrivia is a cyber security consulting company offering risk assessment, security audits, VAPT and compliance consulting to reduce cyber risks.
- [AI Security Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/ai-security/): Protect AI applications and LLMs with AI security services from CipherTrivia. Identify AI vulnerabilities and reduce risks through security testing and expert guidance.
- [LLM Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/llm-security-testing/): LLM security testing for chatbots, copilots and generative AI apps. Find prompt injection, data leakage and OWASP LLM Top 10 risks with CipherTrivia.
- [AI Agent Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/ai-agent-security-testing/): AI agent security testing for autonomous agents, tools and permissions. Find excessive agency, tool abuse and identity risks with CipherTrivia.
- [Post-Quantum Cryptography Security Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/post-quantum-cryptography-security/): Post-quantum cryptography services to assess encryption risk, inventory your cryptography and plan a quantum-safe migration with CipherTrivia.
- [Digital Identity and Deepfake Security Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/digital-identity-deepfake-security/): Deepfake and digital identity security services: test KYC, liveness, voice and help desk checks against impersonation and synthetic identity fraud.
- [IoT and OT Security Testing Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/services/iot-ot-security/): IoT and OT security testing for connected devices, ICS and SCADA, smart infrastructure and robotics. Find risks safely with CipherTrivia.
- [Penetration Testing Services Company in Bangalore](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/penetration-testing-company-bangalore/): We are a leading penetration testing in service company in Bangalore for web and mobile apps, APIs and networks, with validated findings and remediation guidance.

- [Common Architecture-Level Risk Areas We Identify](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/architecture-level-security-risks/): Across enterprise systems, the same categories of design-level risk appear repeatedly.
- [Security Gaps Our DevSecOps Services Close](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/cicd-security-gaps-devsecops-closes/): Most organizations have CI/CD pipelines that build and deploy without a single automated security check.
- [Common Vulnerabilities Our API Security Testing Services Find](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/common-api-security-vulnerabilities/): The OWASP API Security Top 10 defines the vulnerability categories that matter most for APIs.
- [Common Cloud Security Risk Areas We Assess](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/common-cloud-security-risk-areas/): Across AWS, Azure and GCP assessments, a handful of risk categories account for the majority of high and critical findings.
- [Common Vulnerabilities Our Mobile Application Security Testing Finds](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/common-mobile-app-vulnerabilities/): Across Android and iOS engagements, these six vulnerability classes account for most of the high and critical findings in our mobile application security testing reports.
- [Common Vulnerabilities Our VAPT Security Services Find](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/common-vulnerabilities-vapt-finds/): Across web, mobile, API and cloud assessments, a handful of vulnerability classes account for most of the high and critical findings in our reports.
- [Common Vulnerabilities Our Web Application Security Testing Uncovers](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/common-web-application-vulnerabilities/): Across hundreds of web application security testing engagements, the same vulnerability classes appear repeatedly.
- [Core Consulting Areas Within Our Cybersecurity Consulting Services](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/core-cybersecurity-consulting-areas/): Each consulting area addresses a distinct dimension of your security program. Depending on organizational maturity, engagements may focus on one area or span all six.
- [How Attackers Move Through Your Network — and How We Test It](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/how-attackers-move-through-your-network/): Network compromise is rarely a single exploit. Attackers chain together reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, and lateral movement to reach their objective.
- [Open-Source Supply-Chain Attacks Are Now a When, Not an If](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/open-source-supply-chain-attacks/): Compromised npm and PyPI packages have hit CI pipelines across the industry this quarter. Here's what CipherTrivia is seeing, and the controls that actually stop it.
- [Attack Scenarios Our Penetration Testing Services Simulate](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/penetration-testing-attack-scenarios/): Real attackers do not follow scanner checklists. They chain weaknesses, pivot between systems, and exploit trust relationships.
- [Compliance Areas Our Security Compliance Services Address](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/security-compliance-framework-areas/): Each compliance framework targets a different regulatory or contractual requirement, but they share common control domains.
- [The Agents Are Working. Who's Watching the Agents?](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/the-agents-are-working/): A clear-eyed look at how AI is reshaping VAPT, penetration testing, cloud, mobile, web and API security: what genuinely got better, what got more dangerous, and why the human element matters more now, not less.
- [Threat Categories Our SOC as a Service Monitors](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/insights/threat-categories-soc-monitors/): These are the six threat categories that generate the majority of escalated incidents across our managed SOC engagements.

## Whitepapers and guides

- [API Security Best Practices](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/api-security-best-practices/): CipherTrivia's API security team breaks down the OWASP API Security Top 10, real authentication and authorization fix patterns, a secure API architecture, and an FAQ for engineering teams.
- [Cloud Security Assessment Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/cloud-security-assessment-checklist/): A self-audit checklist for AWS, Azure and GCP environments, organized around the five pillars CipherTrivia's cloud security team audits in every engagement.
- [DevSecOps & CI/CD Security Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/devsecops-cicd-security-checklist/): A pipeline-stage-by-stage DevSecOps security checklist from CipherTrivia: what to check at commit, build, test, package and deploy, with a secure CI/CD reference diagram.
- [Enterprise VAPT Guide](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/enterprise-vapt-guide/): A practical guide to scoping, running and acting on Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) engagements at enterprise scale.
- [Identity & Access Management Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/identity-access-management-checklist/): An identity-lifecycle IAM checklist from CipherTrivia covering joiner, mover, leaver, and privileged access, with the cloud IAM findings we see most often and a least-privilege reference diagram.
- [Incident Response Checklist: The First 72 Hours](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/incident-response-checklist/): A first-72-hours incident response checklist from CipherTrivia's incident response team, covering what to do, in order, when you suspect a breach, plus a readiness checklist to prepare before one happens.
- [Mobile App Security Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/mobile-app-security-checklist/): A teardown-style mobile app security checklist from CipherTrivia's mobile security team, covering iOS and Android: what we look at first, what we usually find, and how to fix it.
- [Network Security Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/network-security-checklist/): Three real attack paths CipherTrivia's network security team uses during internal penetration tests, a segmentation reference diagram, and a two-tier checklist for hardening your network.
- [OWASP Top 10 Security Guide](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/owasp-top-10-security-guide/): CipherTrivia's penetration testing team breaks down the OWASP Top 10 (2021) with real fix patterns, engagement data, a secure reference architecture and an FAQ for engineering teams.
- [SOC 2 & ISO 27001 Compliance Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/soc2-iso27001-compliance-checklist/): A practical SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness checklist from CipherTrivia's GRC team, organized by what auditors actually ask for evidence of, not by control numbers.
- [Web Application Security Checklist](https://www.ciphertrivia.com/whitepapers/web-application-security-checklist/): A three-level web application security maturity model from CipherTrivia's testing team: what 'foundational', 'standard' and 'advanced' actually look like, with a checklist for each level.
